title: Shop Pro
short_description: A highly scalable, modern e-commerce platform built with Django, featuring advanced analytics, machine learning integrations, background task processing, and a professional-grade UI tailored for optimal user experience and sales conversion.
full_description:
This project is an enterprise-grade e-commerce application designed to handle end-to-end shopping experiences while providing powerful administrative tools. Beyond a standard storefront, the platform includes dedicated modules for robust marketing, deep analytics, AI-driven insights, extensibility (GraphQL and REST APIs), and sophisticated logistics. It integrates Stripe for secure payment processing and utilizes Celery with Redis for asynchronous background tasks such as sending notifications or generating heavy reports without blocking the main workflow.

The user interface delivers a premium feel with responsive layouts, fluid animations, and a sleek dark/light mode dashboard for admins. With scikit-learn and pandas integrated natively, the platform is capable of analyzing consumer trends, managing product recommendations, and offering dynamic filtering. This project demonstrates mastery of complex backend web architectures, database design, modern front-end aesthetics, and third-party API integration.
technologies: Backend Core & APIs:  Python 3.x Django 4.2+ & Django REST Framework Graphene-Django (GraphQL) Django CORS Headers & Django Filter Database & Data Processing:  SQLite (Development) / PostgreSQL (Production-ready design) Pandas & Scikit-learn (for analytics and AI-driven features) Payments & Tasks:  Stripe API Celery (Task Queue) Redis (Message Broker & Caching) Media & Localization:  Pillow (Image Processing) Django-Money (Currency handling) Django-Modeltranslation (Multi-language support)
requirements:
Support for extensive product catalogs and multi-category filtering
Secure, token-based and session-based authentication methods
High-performance asynchronous background processing for emails and heavy computations
Robust e-commerce modules: User Profiles, Wallets, Reviews, Cart, Wishlists, and Order Management
Scalable APIs supporting both REST and GraphQL structures
Secure payment gateway integration with webhooks handling
Administrator and vendor dashboard with rich data analytics
Localization, CORS compliance, and advanced security configurations

title: SocialHub
short_description: SocialHub — A full-featured social media platform built with Flask, featuring real-time messaging, stories, friend management, emoji reactions, and a complete admin dashboard — inspired by Facebook & Instagram.
full_description:
SocialHub is a full-stack social networking web application built from scratch using Python Flask. It replicates the core experience of platforms like Facebook and Instagram, offering a rich, interactive environment for users to connect, share content, and communicate in real time.

Users can create accounts with email OTP verification or sign in via Google/GitHub OAuth. Once logged in, they can publish rich-text blog posts (with Markdown support, image galleries, and video attachments), react to posts with Facebook-style emoji reactions (👍 ❤️ 😂 😮 😢 😡), bookmark posts for later, share/repost content, and leave threaded comments with inline editing capabilities.

The platform includes a full friend request system (send, accept, decline, remove), a follow/unfollow mechanism with follower & following counts, user blocking, and a real-time private messaging system with group chat support — complete with image attachments and online status indicators powered by WebSockets (Socket.IO).

Inspired by Instagram, users can upload expiring 24-hour stories (images or videos) viewable in a story carousel. The app also features a powerful search system, a dedicated videos feed page, notification badges for unread messages and activity, and a contact form with email delivery.

On the backend, a full admin dashboard provides site-wide analytics, user management (edit roles, delete accounts), post & comment moderation, category & tag management, and reporting tools. The app supports Docker deployment, database migrations via Flask-Migrate, rate limiting, CSRF protection, and caching for production readiness.
requirements:
Python 3.9+
Database	SQLite (dev) / PostgreSQL (prod)
OAuth Credentials	Google & GitHub (optional, for social login)
Docker	Optional (Dockerfile & docker-compose included)

title: Netflix Clone
short_description: A complete, fully functional Netflix clone built using Django, offering video streaming, user authentication, customizable watchlists, progress tracking, and secure subscription management via Stripe.
full_description: This Netflix replica is a full-stack, scalable web application designed to demonstrate advanced backend functionalities with the Django framework and a responsive frontend interface. The project replicates the core user experience of the popular streaming service. Key features include an expansive movie/show catalog, categorized genres (Movies, TV Series, Documentaries), customizable user watchlists, continuous watch-time tracking, and multi-tier subscription plans (Free, Basic, Standard, Premium). Users can securely register, handle payments and subscriptions through an integrated Stripe billing system, and manage their profiles—yielding a complete, end-to-end streaming deployment. It's built for rapid content delivery, robust authentication (JWT), and polished user experience.
technologies: Python, Django,Django REST Framework, JWT (SimpleJWT),HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript (Django Templates), SQLite3,Stripe,Django's built-in File/Image handling capabilities
requirements:
Python 3.x
Django 5.x
Django REST Framework (DRF)
djangorestframework-simplejwt (for API authentication)
Stripe Python Library (for handling payments)
Pillow (for image processing and media handling)
SQLite (default) / PostgreSQL (production)

title: VibeTrack
short_description: VibeTrack is a sophisticated, full-stack music streaming platform engineered with a robust hybrid API architecture. It delivers seamless high-fidelity audio playback, intelligent search integration, and an enterprise-grade user management system, all wrapped in a high-end, responsive interface.
full_description:
VibeTrack was designed to solve the challenge of building a resilient media platform with external API dependencies. By implementing a custom-engineered hybrid search engine, the platform ensures 100% uptime for its music catalog by intelligently switching between multiple global data providers.

Key Technical Achievements:

Custom Media Architecture: Developed a professional-grade React audio engine featuring precise state synchronization, non-blocking playback, and smooth seeking logic.
Intelligent Hybrid Discovery: Engineered a multi-source search system that aggregates metadata from various streaming APIs, featuring automated query expansion and optimized result merging.
Event-Driven UI Sync: Implemented a global event notification system to ensure real-time UI consistency for playlist management and user preferences across all application layers.
Premium Tier Logic: A secure, database-backed access control system managing content gating and personalized user experiences.
Modern Performance: Built on a foundation of Next.js and FastAPI, the platform utilizes Turbopack and async database scaling to maintain sub-second response times.
technologies: Frontend: Next.js (App Router), React, Zustand (State Management), Lucide React (Icons), Vanilla CSS. Backend: FastAPI (Python), SQLAlchemy (ORM), Pydantic (Data Validation), Uvicorn. Database: PostgreSQL (Primary Store), Redis (Caching & Sessions). APIs: Spotify Web API, Jamendo API. DevOps: Docker, Nginx, Turbopack.
requirements:
Node.js: v18.0 or higher
Python: v3.10 or higher
Docker: (Recommended for local database/redis setup)
API Credentials: Spotify Developer Client ID/Secret, Jamendo Client ID.
technologies_list: Redis (Caching & Sessions). APIs: Spotify Web API
